account-manager.trigger: proactive account check-ins, stale client contact, or an account review
account-manager.swap: Replace Gmail/CRM adapters with your mail and customer systems.
steps: Read active accounts and last-contact dates.
Draft one factual update per due account.
Save drafts only; require approval before sending.
Record approved status changes through status-update.

asset-population.trigger: a finished layout needs real logos, photography, icons, or motifs
asset-population.swap: Replace InDesign/CMS placement with the target design tool's asset API.
steps: Read the copy and identify each asset slot's job.
Resolve approved assets from the brand profile.
Place assets without distorting, inventing, or silently cropping meaning.
Review each section visually through edit-design.

autosave.trigger: periodic save checkpoints or context-compaction risk
autosave.swap: Point the state path at your own private, ignored store.
steps: Summarize current task, decisions, blockers, and next action.
Write only to a private ignored state file.
Never include credentials or client data in a public tree.

brand-research-dossier.trigger: new-brand research, competitor analysis, or pre-mood-board discovery
brand-research-dossier.swap: Use your preferred search and browser-capture tools.
steps: Load the approved brief and known brand facts.
Research market, competitors, audience signals, and visual conventions.
Separate sourced facts from recommendations.
Deliver an internal dossier; do not publish it.

brandscript.trigger: brand story, positioning narrative, or foundational messaging
brandscript.swap: Use any structured brand repository that can supply approved facts.
steps: Load the brand profile and interview inputs.
Draft who, what, why, how, audience, promise, and proof.
Keep claims evidence-based and voice-consistent.
Run copyeditor before review.

brief-machine.trigger: a contractor or teammate needs a production brief
brief-machine.swap: Replace Gmail/task creation with your team communication stack.
steps: Resolve scope, owner, inputs, deliverables, deadline, and acceptance criteria.
Ask only for facts that cannot be looked up.
Draft the brief.
Route through team-comms; never send without the configured approval.

build-etransfer-invoice.trigger: an approved billing milestone requires an invoice draft
build-etransfer-invoice.deps: accounting provider, Stripe or bank transfer, optional InDesign
build-etransfer-invoice.swap: Replace payment rails and tax rules with your jurisdiction and accounting tool.
steps: Verify the contract milestone and billing identity.
Select the approved payment rail and tax treatment.
Create a draft invoice from placeholders and read it back.
Require owner approval before issuing or sending.

captain.trigger: system status board, capability inventory, or build audit
captain.swap: Use your issue tracker or project database as the status source.
steps: Inventory system work only, not client records.
Classify blocked, broken, active, scheduled, parked, and complete.
Attach evidence for status claims.
Reconcile all counts before publishing the board.

colour-information.trigger: accurate HEX, RGB, CMYK, or spot-colour information is required
colour-information.swap: Use another colour-managed application; do not substitute naive formulas. scripts/brand_tokens.py can also read print-PDF vectors through optional PyMuPDF, which is not pinned in requirements.txt.
steps: Read the source swatch through a colour-managed engine.
Record the engine-returned values and colour profile.
Do not invent spot-colour matches.
Pass digital combinations to palette-qa.

copyeditor.trigger: proofreading, correctness, consistency, or final editorial QA
steps: Check facts and internal consistency.
Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style.
Remove unsupported claims and generic AI phrasing.
Perform a clean final read after edits.

copywriting.deps: brand profile and approved offer facts
copywriting.swap: Use your own brand repository and CMS.
steps: Confirm audience, offer, page goal, and proof.
Build the message hierarchy.
Draft headlines, body, proof, objections, and calls to action.
Run editorial-copy then copyeditor.

delegation-oscillation.trigger: deciding whether the owner, agent, or teammate should perform work
delegation-oscillation.swap: Replace the task manager and rate/capacity inputs.
steps: Identify the decision, required judgment, reversibility, and access.
Compare owner attention with delegation overhead.
Choose a responsible role, not a named person.
If delegated, hand off through brief-machine.

design-best-practices.trigger: any print, web, social, or hybrid visual task
design-best-practices.swap: Point references at your own approved design doctrine.
steps: Load medium-specific constraints and brand tokens.
Check hierarchy, composition, typography, spacing, contrast, and production constraints.
Record decisions that affect downstream build.
Return control to the production skill.

developwebsite.trigger: an approved web build specification is ready for implementation
developwebsite.swap: Replace the CMS adapter with Webflow, a framework, or another builder.
steps: Validate the approved build spec.
Build tokens and reusable components before pages.
Populate approved copy and assets.
Test responsive behavior, accessibility, forms, and analytics without publishing.

ea-protocol.trigger: session start, daily briefing, catch-up, or agenda setting
ea-protocol.swap: Replace each read adapter independently; preserve read-before-analysis order.
steps: Read calendar, inbox, task manager, and financial signals.
Present source-grounded sections sequentially.
Separate facts, risks, and recommendations.
Set the session agenda and hand production-ready work to project-pipeline.

ea-wrapup.trigger: session end, logging off, or explicit wrap-up
ea-wrapup.deps: task manager, Slack, private state store
ea-wrapup.swap: Replace Motion/Slack with your project and team tools.
steps: Reconcile completed, open, delegated, and blocked work.
Draft task/status updates and a team summary.
Require approval for external communication.
Save private continuation state; never commit it.

edit-design.trigger: every visual edit to HTML, CSS, SVG, InDesign, or another design surface
edit-design.swap: Use the target application's capture/export mechanism.
steps: Name the section and intended visual change.
Inspect the current output.
Make one bounded change.
Capture and inspect the result.
Check neighboring sections and production constraints.
Repeat until the section passes.

editorial-copy.trigger: existing marketing copy needs stronger persuasion or clarity
steps: Review clarity, voice, specificity, proof, objections, risk, and action.
Revise one sweep at a time.
Preserve approved facts.
Finish with copyeditor.

email-send.trigger: an approved email is ready for delivery preparation
email-send.swap: Replace campaign creation and test-send adapters with your ESP.
steps: Confirm written approval and audience consent.
Create a new campaign from approved HTML.
Run link, rendering, sender, and unsubscribe checks.
Send a test only; require explicit approval to schedule or send live.

email-workflow.trigger: newsletter, campaign, nurture, automation, template, or list-hygiene work
email-workflow.swap: Replace the ESP while retaining consent, suppression, and approval gates.
steps: Classify template, one-off campaign, sequence, automation, or hygiene.
Verify audience consent and suppression rules.
Route builds to newsletter-build and delivery to email-send.
Keep all live actions approval-gated.

health-coach.trigger: food, meal, nutrition, weight, body-composition, workout, or health check-in
health-coach.calls: scripts/health_validate.py, scripts/health_targets.py, scripts/health_log_lint.py, scripts/health_daily_union.py, scripts/health_usda.py, scripts/_health_meal_calc.py, scripts/burn_estimate.py
health-coach.deps: Python, PyYAML, sourced catalog; optional USDA_API_KEY
health-coach.swap: Replace fitness providers freely, but never replace the catalog provenance validator.
steps: Load the private profile and today's private log.
Resolve every nutrition number to a catalog entry with an allowed source.
Validate the entire catalog before quoting or logging macros.
Lint meal logs and regenerate daily read models from their owned food and burn sources.
Calculate portions and recipe totals from catalog values only.
Compute targets with Mifflin-St Jeor for the profile's stated sex. Do not assume a sex.
Mark burn estimates as estimates and exclude them from measured-history training data.
Write private logs outside the public repo.
Do not diagnose or replace medical care.

hoarding-pipeline.trigger: asset intake starts or required materials are missing
hoarding-pipeline.deps: Google Drive or file storage, Gmail
steps: Generate an asset checklist from deliverable requirements.
Catalog received files without embedding them in this repo.
Draft requests for missing material.
Start only reversible internal work until intake is complete.

icon-selection.trigger: a visual layout needs icons, motifs, or supporting graphics
icon-selection.swap: Use your own licensed icon library.
steps: Define the communication job.
Choose one coherent visual grammar.
Check optical weight, stroke, scale, and licensing.
Place and review through edit-design.

identify-brand-identity.trigger: brand ingestion or the first brand-matched deliverable
steps: Inventory supplied and public brand sources.
Extract approved logos, typography, colours, imagery rules, voice, and constraints.
Mark source and confidence for each fact.
Write a private brand profile outside this public template.

illustrator-batch-export.trigger: batch export of logos, icons, patterns, or artboards from Illustrator
illustrator-batch-export.deps: Adobe Illustrator, ExtendScript, Windows or macOS
illustrator-batch-export.swap: Use Illustrator actions or another vector application's scripting API.
steps: Inspect the document and define export naming and formats.
Generate a reviewable .jsx file on disk; never hide it in an inline shell command.
Run against a copy or versioned source.
Verify counts, dimensions, colour mode, and untouched master artwork.

inventory-counts-reconcile.trigger: a document contains categorical counts, rollups, or a definition-of-done table
steps: Recount from the itemized source.
Check every subtotal against its parent total.
Separate current, archived, experimental, and adjacent items.
Refuse publication while any count is unreconciled.

launch-indesign-mcp.trigger: InDesign automation is needed or its connection fails
launch-indesign-mcp.deps: Windows, Adobe InDesign, pywin32; optional external UXP/MCP bridge
launch-indesign-mcp.swap: On non-Windows hosts, set INDESIGN_BRIDGE_URL and use the external UXP bridge or another InDesign automation host. Set SVETLANA_ID_TRANSPORT to com, http, or auto.
steps: Try a real COM round-trip first.
If COM is unavailable, post to INDESIGN_BRIDGE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3000).
Treat a returned value as health; do not trust a status flag alone.
Never close or overwrite a document the agent did not open.

marketing-deliverable.trigger: any requested design or marketing deliverable
marketing-deliverable.swap: Replace production adapters while preserving review gates.
steps: Load brief, brand profile, copy, assets, and constraints.
Choose the medium-specific production skill.
Create internal drafts through edit-design.
Preflight copy, visual quality, and output specs.
Deliver for owner review, never publish automatically.

meeting-ingest.trigger: a meeting summary or transcript arrives
meeting-ingest.deps: Gmail, Motion or another note taker, CRM
meeting-ingest.swap: Replace the meeting-note and CRM adapters.
steps: Verify the meeting and participants from approved sources.
Extract decisions, commitments, dates, and status changes.
Update private project/brand context.
Draft follow-ups and route production work without sending.

newsletter-build.swap: Replace Mailchimp with your ESP; retain rendering and consent checks.
steps: Confirm audience, purpose, content, and approved template.
Build conservative email HTML.
Run copy, links, size, accessibility, and client rendering checks.
Hand approved output to email-send.

offload.trigger: work should be captured for later rather than done now
offload.swap: Replace task creation with your queue system.
steps: Look up context before asking questions.
Specify outcome, inputs, constraints, acceptance criteria, and next review.
Create a draft task assigned to the configured owner role.
Do not silently schedule or message anyone.

opportunity-engine.trigger: revenue-move review or an approved deliverable/deal creates a follow-up opportunity
steps: Read current consented CRM records.
Identify evidence-based next offers or follow-ups.
Rank by fit and timing, not vanity metrics.
Draft actions only; commercial messages require consent and approval.

paintbrush.trigger: an approved layout needs brand colour and typography applied
paintbrush.swap: Replace swatch/style APIs for the target application.
steps: Load approved brand tokens.
Map semantic roles to named swatches and text styles.
Apply colour and typography only.
Review through edit-design, then hand off assets to asset-population.

palette-qa.trigger: a palette needs WCAG and light/dark usability checks
palette-qa.swap: Any standards-compliant contrast engine can replace the script.
steps: Test every intended foreground/background pair.
Report normal and large-text thresholds.
Suggest hue-preserving alternatives without changing approved source colours.
Require human judgment before adopting alternatives.

printlayoutdesign.trigger: proposal, guide, magazine, card, sign, sheet, or other print layout
printlayoutdesign.deps: InDesign, Windows COM or UXP bridge, Playwright for measured HTML comps
printlayoutdesign.swap: Replace InDesign transfer with another professional layout engine.
steps: Load brief, copy, brand tokens, references, and print specs.
Solve hierarchy and pagination in a measured comp.
Transfer approved geometry into InDesign in small paced calls.
Apply styles and assets.
Run structural and export preflight before review.

project-pipeline.trigger: a new internal or client deliverable starts
project-pipeline.deps: task manager and private project state
project-pipeline.swap: Replace Motion/private state with your project system.
steps: Classify the deliverable and responsible role.
Ingest brand, copy, assets, and constraints.
Route to the correct production skill.
Record review outcomes and remaining work in private state.

reference-capture.trigger: a URL, video, or HTML reference must be deconstructed
steps: Capture the complete reference, including lazy-loaded states.
Record viewport, interaction, typography, spacing, motion, and components.
Separate observed facts from interpretation.
Write a build-oriented reference spec.

sales-manager.trigger: pipeline, forecast, lead-stage, or revenue-priority review
sales-manager.swap: Replace CRM reads and your private financial thresholds.
steps: Read current CRM stages and confirmed amounts.
Separate confirmed, probable, and speculative pipeline.
Identify next actions with evidence.
Never include private financial records in this repository.

social-media-management.trigger: social account onboarding, monthly planning, production, or reporting
social-media-management.swap: Replace platform-specific scheduling and reporting adapters.
steps: Confirm account goals, audience, consent, and channel rules.
Plan covers and grid before full production.
Create and review copy/visuals.
Require explicit approval before scheduling or publishing.
Report outcomes against business goals.

status-update.trigger: a lead, client, deal, or project gains a status-relevant fact
status-update.swap: Replace CRM writes with your system's reviewed upsert.
steps: Extract only explicit status facts.
Read the existing record first.
Prepare a minimal patch with provenance.
Require approval before writing external CRM data.

svetlana-slackbot-connect.trigger: the local Slack bot must start, reconnect, or be checked
svetlana-slackbot-connect.deps: Slack, Node or Python bot runtime
svetlana-slackbot-connect.swap: Replace Slack with Teams, Discord, or another approved channel.
steps: Check whether the bot is already healthy.
Start one supervised instance if absent.
Verify identity and channel allowlists.
Never post during a connectivity check.

tagline.trigger: tagline, slogan, motto, or short brand line
steps: Load positioning, audience, promise, voice, and naming constraints.
Explore distinct strategic territories.
Remove generic, unprovable, and category-cliché options.
Present a short rationale and run copyeditor.

team-comms.trigger: a teammate needs a routine brief or an approved internal message
team-comms.deps: Slack or Gmail, private team roster
team-comms.swap: Replace channel adapters and roster source.
steps: Resolve the recipient through an allowlisted role roster.
Write as Svetlana, never impersonating the owner.
Send only pre-authorized routine briefs; draft everything else.
Never use this path for clients or vendors.

web-conversion-doctrine.trigger: before any website layout or build
web-conversion-doctrine.swap: Replace reference doctrine with your approved web standards.
steps: Check page intent, audience stage, and conversion path.
Apply legitimate information architecture, proof, accessibility, SEO, analytics, and form principles.
Return constraints to the execution skill.

websitelayoutdesign.trigger: website wireframe, page layout, or approved web-design comp
websitelayoutdesign.swap: Use Figma or another measured layout surface if it can emit a build spec.
steps: Load approved copy, brand tokens, page goal, and references.
Build a measured responsive comp.
Review each section through edit-design.
Emit a machine-readable build spec.
Hand approved output to developwebsite.
